source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The NNTP subscription server must update subscribed paths before calling stopPopulating. A missing path can be created even by isSubscribable; new nodes default to non-subscribable, and the JS gate leaves those rows unselected. Native stopPopulating notifies the listener, whose current UI consumer installs the displayed tree adapter. The small historical repair accepts subscribed entries also appearing in New Groups. It does not implement the proposed general read-only query redesign. This is a scoped ordering contract, not an executed crash fix.
title: Finish NNTP subscription tree mutations before population completion
